Hmmmm, I feel like cloistering myself
away right now.

Hmmm, then...will you make an offering,
Kaede?

to get His energy back.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time trying to persuade Angie
that she doesn't need my blood...
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie and I grew a little closer today.
